items.title: Ethlabs Drops Quick Slots Push to Chase a Post-Quantum Ethereum by 2027
items.summary: The lab is withdrawing its Quick Slots proposal from Hegotá to focus on making Ethereum post-quantum, and plausibly post-AI, in 2027.

items.title: Akash Opens One-Way AKT Migration to Solana
items.summary: Holders can now lock AKT on Cosmos and receive the same amount on Solana, a one-way move that stays open for two years.

items.title: 🏴 Variational's Broker Bet Goes Public
items.summary: Omni’s private beta is over, and its single dealer design is about to face a much bigger test.
